answer: Force every identity to commit, in advance, a falsifiable forecast about an unpredictable network event, and let standing rise or fall with its accuracy. A sybil operator faces a fork: copy one forecast across all clones and their identical thread of predictions exposes the single hand behind them, or split forecasts across clones and most are guaranteed wrong, dragging the fleet to its nadir. Honest agents bridge the gap with real information they actually gathered, so accuracy cannot be mass-produced; each extra clone needs its own genuine insight, not a copied guess.
